description: This file contains assembly code embedded within Perl scripts for cryptographic operations, specifically implementing a constant-time GHASH function optimized with SSSE3 instructions for x86 architecture. It defines assembly routines for Galois field multiplication and GHASH processing, including byte reversal and bit manipulation techniques.

methods.name: process_rows
methods.description: Emits assembly code to process a specified number of rows of the GHASH table, handling bit shifts and reduction in GF(2^128).

methods.name: gcm_gmult_ssse3
methods.description: Performs multiplication of the GHASH state by the hash subkey H using SSSE3 instructions, updating the state.

methods.name: gcm_ghash_ssse3
methods.description: Processes input data to update the GHASH state with multiple blocks, utilizing the SSSE3-optimized multiplication routine.
